generic.title: Title
generic.max_consumer_branches: Limit quantity of consumer branches (0 for unlimited)

power_sankey.show_total_consumption: Show total consumption above the diagram's center
power_sankey.max_power: Power at full line thickness (optional, W)
power_sankey.animation_wave_length: Length of each animation wave (default 48 px)
power_sankey.animation_brightness: Brightness of the animation waves (1 = default)
power_sankey.animation_rate_scaled: Faster animation on flows carrying more power
power_sankey.invert_battery_flows: Battery flows are positive for charging
power_sankey.battery_charge_only_from_generation: Batteries can only charge from generated power
power_sankey.battery_charge_from_generation_first: Batteries charge from generated power first
power_sankey.battery_hint_std: Power from battery (one combined in/out per battery, positive = discharging)
power_sankey.battery_hint_inverted: Power to battery (one combined in/out per battery, positive = charging)
power_sankey.independent_grid_in_out: Use separate sensors for grid in/out
power_sankey.unknown_source_color: Unknown generation color: CSS color or template (optional)
power_sankey.unknown_source_to_grid: Count unknown generation as grid power instead of showing it
power_sankey.grid_secondary_entity: Value shown above the grid icon (optional)
power_sankey.generation_secondary_entity: Value shown above the generation icon (optional)
power_sankey.grid_color: Grid color: CSS color or template (optional)
power_sankey.generation_color: Generation color: CSS color or template (optional)

energy_sankey.battery_charge_only_from_generation: Batteries can only charge from generated energy
energy_sankey.battery_charge_from_generation_first: Batteries charge from generated energy first
